status: Development contracts frozen before probe execution and before downloading target fixed snapshots
unresolved_alternative: The mechanism may be absent, multiple causes may interact, and a probe may be invalid.

common_contract.preconditions: Import pinned source from a fresh source copy under the recorded Python environment; require the recorded state fingerprint.
common_contract.controls: Same code snapshot, interpreter, installed packages, and explicit inputs; new working directory and process each run.
common_contract.restoration: Run in a disposable source copy; retain results; never modify cached source snapshots.
common_contract.extractor: JSON output contains observations. Their diagnostic interpretation requires review; no usefulness label is inferred automatically.

hypotheses.width: Custom bar layout has incorrect width allocation or truncation.
hypotheses.encoding: Unicode or ANSI width accounting is responsible.
hypotheses.statistics: Progress statistics rather than layout cause the failure.

probes.change: Sweep ncols with fixed ASCII bar_format and fixed statistics.

predictions.width: Width-dependent missing/extra content or exceptions may occur on ASCII.
predictions.encoding: Plain ASCII layouts should remain consistent.
predictions.statistics: Changing width alone should not alter progress statistics.

probes.change: Hold width and statistics fixed, vary plain, ANSI-colored, and wide-character prefixes.

predictions.width: ASCII may fail too; encoding is not required.
predictions.encoding: Mismatch is restricted to or worsened by styled/wide prefixes.
predictions.statistics: Changing prefix alone should not alter numeric statistics.

probes.change: Hold layout fixed, vary n, total, and elapsed.

predictions.width: Failures depend on layout occupancy as number widths change.
predictions.encoding: ASCII-only statistics should not need Unicode handling.
predictions.statistics: Unexpected percentages or iteration counts appear independently of custom formatting.

probes.change: Use default, full custom, bar-only, and right-side-only formats at fixed width.

predictions.width: Some custom layouts fail while default output can remain valid.
predictions.encoding: ASCII-only layouts should not require encoding-sensitive logic.
predictions.statistics: Numeric fields remain wrong across formats containing them.

hypotheses.dispatch: Output destination is handled with an incompatible interface.
hypotheses.filesystem: Path availability or file creation causes the failure.
hypotheses.encoding: Text encoding causes file output to fail.

probes.change: Trace identical ASCII function to StringIO, a file path, and stderr.

predictions.filesystem: In-memory output works; file output fails.
predictions.encoding: ASCII should not require non-ASCII encoding support.

probes.change: Trace to an absent path and an existing writable file in a verified temporary directory.

predictions.dispatch: Both path strings can fail regardless of file existence.
predictions.filesystem: Failure depends on path existence or actual writeability.
predictions.encoding: ASCII should remain writeable in both states.

probes.change: Hold destination and function shape fixed; compare ASCII and non-ASCII values.

predictions.dispatch: Both values fail for the incompatible destination.
predictions.filesystem: Both fail at the same path if access is the issue.

probes.change: Compare undecorated return value with traced return value and restored sys.gettrace().

predictions.dispatch: Undecorated control succeeds; some tracing destinations fail.
predictions.filesystem: Control succeeds and file destinations alone fail.
predictions.encoding: ASCII trace control succeeds; failure needs non-ASCII input.

hypotheses.lookup: Entity lookup or numeric conversion is incorrect.
hypotheses.matching: Entity boundaries or adjacent entities are matched incorrectly.
hypotheses.recursion: Escaped ampersands are decoded at the wrong number of levels.

probes.change: Compare isolated named, decimal, hexadecimal, and unknown entities.

predictions.lookup: One entity class fails in isolation.
predictions.matching: Isolated entities can pass while composed inputs fail.

probes.change: Compare each isolated entity with adjacency and text separated by ampersands.

predictions.lookup: Failure persists for the same entity alone and in composition.
predictions.matching: Composed strings fail despite correctly decoded isolated entities.
predictions.recursion: Failures concentrate on encoded ampersands rather than ordinary adjacency.

probes.change: Vary semicolons, text suffixes, and unknown entities without changing known entity names.

predictions.lookup: Terminated valid entities fail even in simple inputs.
predictions.recursion: Boundary changes without escaped ampersands need not fail.

probes.change: Observe one and two applications on nested ampersand escapes; no assumption of idempotence.

predictions.lookup: Unexpected characters appear even at a single simple decoding level.
predictions.matching: Neighboring escaped sequences interfere with matching.
predictions.recursion: The number of decoded levels differs from ordinary one-pass decoding.
